column4: The exact same cathedral interior, same camera, same pews and the same hooded congregants in the same seats as the reference, hoods fully on, no faces shown. Change only their posture, strongly and in every row, especially the large front row: in the reference they are hunched with heads bowed low over their books; now every figure sits bolt upright, shoulders back, and has thrown its head back to gaze straight up at the high window. Their hooded heads now rise clearly higher above the pew backs than in the reference, the hood peaks tip backward toward the viewer, and the books are lowered into their laps. The silhouettes are noticeably taller and upturned.
